test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A hemispherical bowl is made of 1 cm thick steel. The inside radius of the bowl is 4 cm. The volume of the steel (in cm³) used in making the bowl is:
solution:
Given :

The inner radius of the bowl r1 = 4 cm

The thickness of the bowl = 1 cm

The outer radius of the bowl r2 = 4 + 1 = 5 cm

Formula Used :

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3) πr3

Calculation :

The volume of steel used in the bowl (V) = Volume of the outer hemisphere - Volume of the inner hemisphere

⇒ V = (2/3) πr23 - (2/3) πr13

⇒ V = (2/3) × π × (r23 - r13)

⇒ V = (2/3) × π × (53 - 43)

⇒ V = (2/3) × π × (125 - 64)

⇒ V = (122/3) × π 

⇒ V = 40 (2)/(3) pi

∴ The volume of the steel used in the bowl = 40 (2)/(3) pi cm3.
